## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 13.08.2026 - 22.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Leemiz_, 22.08.2026, 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            2. _Vadim Belenky_, 20.08.2026, 1/5: "too much ads and too much push towards the premium. Data on food is not reliable. Considering alternatives!!!"
            3. _Derrick Wilson_, 20.08.2026, 1/5: "I tried to cancel the subscription & it's not allowing me to remove the auto renewal & will not show up in my subscription to cancel."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.05.2026 - 23.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Vipul Uchil_, 23.08.2026, 1/5: "app is more or less unusable after the latest update, which is definitely vibe coded because some MBA decided to fire all the UX professionals at the company. they took a perfectly intuitive and functional app and destroyed it for no reason at all. the new app is not user friendly in any way, actively prevents you from finding information, prevents you from quickly logging food. why would you ever use a food logging app when it takes you forever to log a single item of food? use cronometer."
            2. _enka cacka_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
